title: feat(nm2frm2sy): directed 2-step cyclic-frame transport along -e2 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Directed 2-step -e2 on two-axis opposite, per-site tau. Only B=(0,1,0) completes both hops; A and D lose the second hop, C loses the first. Recomputed independently: bits A/B/C/D = fail/hold/fail/fail, matching. The rival +e1 2-step is computed in the same runner and also fails, which is a genuine (if narrow) discriminator.
